claim: Which difficulty a sprite appears on is XSPRITE lSkill, a mask of five LOCKOUT bits: a set bit for difficulty n deletes the sprite at level start. Four masks carry 1,872 of the campaign's 1,959 masked sprites: 7 (only on the two hardest, 699), 3 (not on the two easiest, 665), 15 (only on the hardest, 317), 1 (not on the easiest, 191). The rest are mostly the reverse, things removed from the harder: 28 (only on the two easiest, 26), 24 (only on the three easiest, 20).
evidence: 2026-11-26 recount of launch_skill over the 43 campaign maps: 7 x699, 3 x665, 15 x317, 1 x191, 28 x26, 24 x20, ten other masks x31 (projects/blood-city/level/difficulty.py's docstring names only the four)
use: Set the bits a foe is NOT on, counting from the easiest; thin and add foes per difficulty as difficulty.py does.
